name: parse fixed-width records with numeric fields
definition: Split byte-aligned records into fields with fixed character widths, including a right-aligned zero-padded numeric field, without misalignment on adjacent records.
failure_mode: A wrong record width or field boundary corrupts balances or ownership keys and the final bytes do not match.

name: parse heterogeneous inputs (json csv parquet) into one schema
definition: load per-record data from three sources each in a different format and map differently-named but synonymous fields to a canonical set.
failure_mode: a source unparsed or a field unmapped yields missing users/columns
